* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Force Is Strong In My Family (Errata)]]): PC errata of 21 April 2022; card image marked E1 published 21 April 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Light/large/theforceisstronginmyfamily.gif</code> as published 21 April 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/theforceisstronginmyfamily.gif holotable commit 3f7288d] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-PC-E1">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/2293de287fa9905748ec7d665488e465872dbe4a swccg-card-json commit 2293de287f] (21 April 2022): dating evidence only.</ref>: “Deploy on table (only at start of game) and choose: My Father Has It: Anakin (and [Episode I] Obi-Wan) I Have It: Luke (and [Set 1] Obi-Wan) You Have That Power, Too: Rey (and [Episode VII] Luke) [Set 16] Anakin is deploy -1. Your total Force generation is +1. You may not deploy Boss Nass' Chambers or Jedi (except Yoda and the chosen characters). If you just initiated battle involving a Skywalker (or if opponent's Sidious just lost from table), may retrieve 1 Force.” The PC re-rendered the image on 5 July 2022 with the same words and E1 mark<ref name="img-rr">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual17-Light/large/theforceisstronginmyfamily.gif</code> as published 5 July 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual17-Light/large/theforceisstronginmyfamily.gif holotable commit a41bae9] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref> (part of a re-rendering of every Virtual Set 17 image; not counted as a separate version here). '''What changed:''' “(reveal corresponding characters from Reserve Deck)” was dropped after “choose”; the [Reflections II] icon before “Luke” in I Have It was dropped; “[Set 16] Anakin is deploy -1.” was added; “non-battleground locations (except Saddle and huts)” became “Boss Nass' Chambers”; “the revealed cards” became “the chosen characters”. The card gained the E1 mark.
